title: Dynamic Cheatsheet: Test-Time Learning with Adaptive Memory
authors_zh: Mirac Suzgun、Mert Yuksekgonul、Dan Jurafsky（斯坦福大学）；Federico Bianchi（Together AI）；James Zou（斯坦福大学、Together AI）
paper_type_zh: 自适应记忆测试时学习研究
best_for_zh: 研究无需参数更新、却能让多次推理努力跨任务累积的读者。
one_line: Dynamic Cheatsheet uses self-curated persistent memory so a black-box model can reuse lessons discovered during earlier inference episodes.
Dynamic Cheatsheet 通过自整理的持久记忆，让黑箱模型复用先前推理过程中发现的策略、代码和纠错经验。
why: It expands test-time scaling from repeated attempts on one prompt to accumulated, auditable experience over a task stream.
inclusion_reason: It converts accumulated inference experience into a persistent, self-curated memory, making test-time compute reusable across a sequence of reasoning tasks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Standard deployment treats every prompt as an isolated event. A model can spend substantial compute rediscovering the same algebraic trick, code routine, or failure diagnosis on later queries, while a longer context of raw transcripts eventually becomes too costly and noisy to be useful.

Dynamic Cheatsheet asks whether a black-box model can learn during use without changing its parameters or receiving labels. The problem is therefore not only how to solve one hard query with more tokens, but how to turn successful and unsuccessful inference into compact experience that lowers the cost and error rate of subsequent queries.

标准部署把每个提示都当作孤立事件。模型可能在后续查询中花费大量计算，反复发现同一个代数技巧、代码程序或失败原因；而把原始对话记录持续塞进上下文，最终又会变得昂贵、嘈杂且难以使用。

Dynamic Cheatsheet 研究黑箱模型能否在不更新参数、也不接受标签的情况下边使用边学习。因此问题不只是如何用更多词元解决一条困难查询，而是如何把成功和失败的推理转成紧凑经验，降低后续查询的成本与错误率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is a small persistent cheatsheet rather than a growing transcript or a weight update. Before answering, the model retrieves relevant prior lessons; after answering, it decides whether a solution pattern, code fragment, or correction is useful enough to store, revise, merge, or remove.

The memory is deliberately self-curated and concise. It makes the output of one inference episode an input to a later episode, so the unit of test-time scaling becomes a stream of tasks: early computation is an investment whose value is measured by improved future decisions, not only by the first answer.

核心思想是维护一份小型持久速查表，而不是不断增长的对话记录或参数更新。回答前，模型检索相关的既有经验；回答后，它决定某种解题模式、代码片段或纠错是否足够有用，值得存储、修订、合并或删除。

记忆被刻意设计为由模型自整理且保持简洁。它让一次推理的输出成为后续一次推理的输入，因此测试时扩展的单位变成任务流：早期计算是一笔投资，其价值不仅看第一题答案，还看它是否改善之后的决策。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper evaluates cumulative curation and retrieval-and-synthesis variants. A queried model first consults the external memory, generates an answer with any useful strategy or code, and then performs a curation step that retains concise transferable information instead of the full chain of thought.

The reported systems use Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o on AIME, Game of 24, equation balancing, GPQA-Diamond, and MMLU-Pro. The test-time consumer is the memory controller: it allocates calls to retrieval, solving, evaluation-like reflection, and memory maintenance while preserving compatibility with black-box APIs.

论文评估了累积整理以及检索—综合两类变体。被调用的模型先查询外部记忆，结合有用策略或代码生成答案，随后执行整理步骤，只保留简洁且可迁移的信息，而非完整思维链。

报告中的系统使用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 与 GPT-4o，在 AIME、24 点、方程配平、GPQA-Diamond 和 MMLU-Pro 上测试。真正消费测试时资源的是记忆控制器：它把调用分配给检索、求解、类似评估的反思和记忆维护，同时保持与黑箱 API 的兼容性。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On AIME, the paper reports that Claude 3.5 Sonnet more than doubles its accuracy once algebraic insights can persist across questions. On Game of 24, GPT-4o rises from roughly 10% to 99% after discovering and reusing a Python solution, while the paper also reports gains on GPQA-Diamond and MMLU-Pro knowledge tasks.

These results support the claim that carefully curated inference history can be more valuable than repeated independent sampling. They do not show that every stored lesson is correct or transferable: performance depends on task order, memory curation, the proprietary model, and whether a later problem genuinely shares reusable structure.

在 AIME 上，论文报告 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 一旦能跨题保留代数洞见，准确率会提升到原来的两倍以上。在 24 点任务中，GPT-4o 在发现并复用 Python 解法后，从约 10% 升至 99%；论文还报告了 GPQA-Diamond 与 MMLU-Pro 知识任务上的提升。

这些结果支持一个判断：经过谨慎整理的推理历史可能比反复独立采样更有价值。但它们并不证明每条存储经验都正确或可迁移，性能仍取决于任务顺序、记忆整理方式、专有模型能力，以及后续题目是否确实共享可复用结构。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is to make test-time improvement persistent but lightweight. Unlike standard self-consistency, every attempt need not start over; unlike parameter-efficient adaptation, the approach does not require model access; unlike static retrieval, its knowledge store is created and revised by the model’s own experience during deployment.

This changes the accounting of extra compute. The relevant artifact is not just a final answer or a sampled trajectory, but a compact memory item with a provenance in an earlier episode and a measurable effect on a later one. That makes memory quality and curation policy first-class scaling variables.

其独特贡献是让测试时改进具有持久性，同时保持轻量。与标准自一致性不同，每次尝试不必从头开始；与参数高效适应不同，该方法不需要模型访问权限；与静态检索不同，知识库由模型在部署过程中根据自身经验创建和修订。

这改变了额外计算的核算方式。重要产物不再只是最终答案或采样轨迹，还包括一条紧凑记忆：它可追溯到先前一次任务，并能衡量对后续任务的影响。因此记忆质量和整理策略成为一等的扩展变量。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Self-curation can store brittle heuristics, omit counterexamples, or amplify an early mistake across later queries. The reported improvements are sensitive to problem ordering and proprietary model behavior, and a persistent store raises privacy, provenance, and contamination issues that one-shot test-time search does not have; practical use needs versioned memory, deletion policies, task isolation, and evaluation that separates immediate from accumulated benefit.
自整理可能存入脆弱启发式、遗漏反例，或把早期错误放大到后续查询。报告中的提升受题目顺序和专有模型行为影响，持久存储还带来一次性测试时搜索没有的隐私、来源和污染问题；实际使用需要版本化记忆、删除策略、任务隔离，以及区分即时收益与累积收益的评测。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when deployment consists of related queries and the system may safely reuse compact lessons between them. It is especially useful for evaluating whether a costly first attempt should be amortized through an external memory rather than spent again on independent rollouts, and for designing audit trails that link a later answer to the stored lesson that influenced it.
当部署由相互关联的查询组成，且系统能够安全地在查询之间复用紧凑经验时，可使用这篇论文。它特别适合评估一次昂贵的初次尝试是否应通过外部记忆摊销，而不是再次花在独立采样上；也适合设计审计记录，把后续答案关联到实际影响它的那条存储经验。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the curation prompts, ablations against retrieval-only memory, and episode ordering before generalizing the results. The operational question is whether a stored item creates measurable transfer under a held-out task sequence rather than merely repeating an answer; any reproduction should log when an item was written, retrieved, revised, or deleted, and should account for the extra calls used to maintain it.
在推广结果前，应先阅读整理提示、相对于仅检索记忆的消融实验以及任务顺序设置。运行层面的关键问题是，一条存储项是否能在留出的任务序列中产生可测迁移，而不只是重复先前答案；复现时应记录该项何时写入、检索、修订或删除，并核算维护它所增加的调用次数。
